Name: KTG's More Dig Spots
Author: KasualTheGamer
Description:
This is just a simple content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]FarmTypeManager [/url]to increase the number of dig spots that are spawned each day. I have it set up so that each of the spots spawned via this pack have a 4 out of 5 chance to be an artifact spot, with the fifth chance being for a seed spot. These spots work exactly the same as they do in the base game, so you may get coal or clay from artifact spots, or artifacts, and the types of artifacts you'll get are the ones listed on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Artifacts]SDV wiki[/url].

FTM does not offer a way to adjust spawn rates in game, so if you want to tweak the rates, I suggest downloading FTM's content pack editor from their github ([url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/FarmTypeManager/blob/master/FarmTypeManager/ConfigEditor.html]here[/url]) for an easy way to do that. The presets for this content pack are to guarantee at least one dig spot on each map each day.

Note: I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18]Animal Crossing Digspot - Worm Replacement[/url] to change the look of my dig spots.

[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/quirks.png[/img]﻿

[list]
[*]Dig Spots are set to be able to appear on terrain types of Dirt, Grass, or anything the map has marked as "Diggable". Mods that adjust what kinds of terrain you can dig on will affect that. 
[/list]
[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/known-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]There's an issue where every so often, seed spots end up in your inventory and not raked up. ﻿That's been reported to the minds behind FTM, and I'm not sure what the status is about that. You should be able to drop the seed spots from inventory into garbage.
[/list]
[img]https://kasualthegamer.github.io/SDV-Slime-Hutch-Interior/img/notes.png[/img]

This mod is taking part in Nexus Mod's [url=https://help.nexusmods.com/article/112-donation-points-faq]rewards program[/url], with proceeds going 50/50 to the International Red Cross and Doctors without Borders﻿.
